name: AJAX
description: Request and receive other web pages. Note for cross-domain requests (including in preview mode), CORS must be set up on the server.

conditions.description: Triggered when an AJAX request completes successfully.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: A tag, which can be anything you like, to distinguish between different AJAX requests.

conditions.description: Triggered when any AJAX request completes successfully. The 'Tag' expression identifies the request.
Triggered when an AJAX request fails.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: A tag, which can be anything you like, to distinguish between different AJAX requests.

conditions.description: Triggered when any AJAX request fails. The 'Tag' expression identifies the request.
Triggered when an AJAX request has a progress update.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: A tag, which can be anything you like, to distinguish between different AJAX requests.

conditions.description: Triggered when an AJAX request which is uploading data has a progress update.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: A tag, which can be anything you like, to distinguish between different AJAX requests.

actions.description: Request a URL by a GET request and retrieve the server response.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: A tag, which can be anything you like, to distinguish between different AJAX requests.

url.name: URL
url.desc: The URL to request.  Note: most browsers prevent cross-domain requests.

actions.description: Request a file in the project and retrieve its contents.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: A tag, which can be anything you like, to distinguish between different AJAX requests.

file.name: File
file.desc: Select a project file to request.

actions.description: Send data with a request to a URL and retrieve the server response.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: A tag, which can be anything you like, to distinguish between different AJAX requests.

url.name: URL
url.desc: The URL to post to.  Note: most browsers prevent cross-domain posts.

data.name: Data
data.desc: The data to post, in query string form.  Be sure to URLEncode any user-entered data.

method.name: Method
method.desc: The HTTP method to use, typically "POST".

actions.description: Set the maximum time before a request is considered to have failed.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.desc: The timeout for AJAX requests in seconds. Use -1 for no timeout.

actions.description: Set an HTTP header on the next request that is made.

header.name: Header
header.desc: The HTTP header name to set on the request.

value.name: Value
value.desc: A string of the value to set the header to.

actions.description: In the next request, override the MIME type indicated by the response.

mime-type.name: MIME type
mime-type.desc: The MIME type to interpret the response as.

actions.description: Set whether the next request is sent with credentials such as cookies and authorization headers.

with-credentials.name: With credentials
with-credentials.desc: Whether the next request is sent with credentials.

actions.description: Set whether tracking upload progress is enabled. When enabled this can affect cross-domain requests.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether to enable tracking upload progress.

actions.description: Send binary data with a request to a URL and retrieve the server response.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: A tag, which can be anything you like, to distinguish between different AJAX requests.

url.name: URL
url.desc: The URL to post to. Note: most browsers prevent cross-domain posts.

data.name: Data
data.desc: The data to post, from a Binary Data object.

method.name: Method
method.desc: The HTTP method to use, typically "POST".

actions.description: Set a Binary Data object to receive the binary response of the next request.

destination.name: Destination
destination.desc: The Binary Data object to receive the response in to.
